        for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) {

        long bestfreq = 0;

                        long count = entry.getValue();
                        dp[x][y + 1].put(area2, dp[x][y + 1].getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + count);

                        long area2 = totalarea[(int)n][(int)n] - entry.getKey() - totalarea[(int)(n - x)][(int)(n - (y + 1))];

                        long count = entry.getValue();
                        bp[x][y + 1].put(area2, bp[x][y + 1].getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + count);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (int y = 0; y <= n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[x + 1][y] - totalarea[x][y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = entry.getKey() + newarea;
                        long area2 = totalarea[x + 1][(int)n] - c;
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long count = entry.getValue();
                        dp[x + 1][y].put(c, dp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(c, 0L) + count);
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int)(n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[(int)(n - x)][(int)(n - y)] - totalarea[(int)(n - x - 1)][(int)(n - y)];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = entry.getKey() + newarea;
                        if (c > m2) continue;
                        long count = entry.getValue();
                        bp[x + 1][y].put(c, bp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(c, 0L) + count);
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) {
                    dp[x][y].clear();
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) {
                    bp[x][y].clear();
                }
            }
        }

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            int y = (int)(d - x);
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                long c = entry.getKey();
                long freq = entry.getValue();
                long val1 = m1 - c;
                long val2 = m2 - c;
                if (bp[n - x][n - y].containsKey(val1))
                    bestfreq += freq * bp[n - x][n - y].get(val1);
                if (m1 != m2 && bp[n - x][n - y].containsKey(val2))
                    bestfreq += freq * bp[n - x][n - y].get(val2);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
